title: A land run stopped by a fetch timeout records its ops row under the step the stop message names, not rebase
goal: When git fetch times out inside a landing (KB_GIT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT), the land.step ops row names the same step as the 'land stopped at step' line, so ops and the retrospective read the failed step right (SP-honlhzdc: BG-viwywxml's row said step=rebase exit=1 ms=120519 while land printed 'stopped at step fetch: git fetch did not finish within 120 s')
